title: Size of a concentrating Fourier family
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $\varepsilon>0$. The number of subsets $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ for which $\varepsilon\leq \|\widehat f\|_1\,|\widehat f(S)|$ is at most $\|\widehat f\|_1^2/\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube of dimension $n$
